q1_issues.issue: 'in cold winds' is a circumstantial adjunct, not a place, so the thematic Location role mis-slots it — the PP answers 'under what circumstances', not 'where', which the oblique section says routes to the preposition-named (In <event> <wind>) instead.

the bare plural 'cold winds' is encoded as a single witness (sk_wind $x) with Member ... wind / Member ... cold, flattening a plural to one individual instead of the group + distributed-modifier shape the plural doctrine requires.

q2_gaps: a circumstantial restrictor on a NEGATED verbal generic ('Ns never V **in cold winds**'): ConditionalProperty carries such a restriction only for kind-level properties and deontic norms, so a verbal generic's restrictor has nowhere to sit but inside the strength-0.0 consequent, where the denial then also covers the restrictor's own existence (no cold wind satisfies the rule vacuously)

a bare-plural indefinite NP appearing inside a rule consequent: GroupOf is expressible there, but the per-member distribution of its descriptive modifier ('cold') is not, so no licensed encoding of the plural exists in that position
notes: The proper-noun-premodifier route (head noun typed normally + opaque Possession + one Name atom, no fused compound and no invented kind for Northcove), the phrasal verb kept whole as go_out with no genus, 'never' as the strength-0.0 negated verbal generic at confidence 0.9 with its QuantifierPhrase companion, and Patient for the intransitive change-of-state subject are all correct. Only the encoding of the 'in cold winds' adjunct is at issue.
